files.README.md:
# gatekeeper

Rate limiter that sits in front of the public REST API.
Rejects over-limit calls with 429 before they reach upstream.

## Counters

Counters are kept in process memory, one map per replica.
We run a single replica for now, so no shared state is needed.

files.docs/storage.md:
# Shared counter store

## Why Redis over Memcached

The token bucket must read, refill and decrement in one step.
Memcached cannot run the check-and-decrement as one atomic script, so two replicas
can both spend the last token. Redis runs it as a Lua script atomically.

events.message: feat(redis): token bucket as atomic Lua script

files.src/redis/bucket.lua:
local tokens = tonumber(redis.call('HGET', KEYS[1], 't') or ARGV[1])
local last = tonumber(redis.call('HGET', KEYS[1], 'l') or ARGV[3])
tokens = math.min(tonumber(ARGV[1]), tokens + (ARGV[3] - last) * ARGV[2])
local ok = tokens >= 1
if ok then tokens = tokens - 1 end
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], 't', tokens, 'l', ARGV[3])
return ok and 1 or 0
